part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts:61`: when an input source map lacks `sourcesContent`, `TraceMap.sourcesContent` is `undefined`, so `this._inputMap.sourcesContent[i]` threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')` during `new SourceMap`.

The fix guards the access with optional chaining (`this._inputMap.sourcesContent?.[i]`), letting `setSourceContent` propagate the missing content through — which matches what the pre-existing test "inputSourceMap without sourcesContent" in `packages/babel-generator/test/index.js:884` expects (`sourcesContent: [undefined]`).

- Rebuilt via `yarn gulp build-no-bundle`
- `yarn jest packages/babel-generator packages/babel-core/test -i`: 1043 passed (including the previously failing case)
- `yarn jest packages/babel-traverse packages/babel-plugin-transform-modules-commonjs`: 699 passed
- Reproduced the issue's scenario end-to-end with `transformSync` + a `sourcesContent`-less `inputSourceMap` — now succeeds
